inicio_texto: I’m building ERP software with Velneo during my internship and looking for my first junior developer role. If you think I’d be a good fit for your team, I’d love to hear from you.
sobreMi_subtitulo: I’m Jordi, a software development intern.
sobreMi_texto: Games first got me interested in programming. In Atlas de Aethria I worked with turns and game rules. In ShareTicket, the challenge was letting several people use the same shopping list.
habilidadesAptitudes_texto: Before writing code, I try to explain the problem with a concrete example. It helps me plan the work and check with the team that we’re solving the right problem.
proyectos_subtitulo: Web applications, Android apps and games I’ve built.
proyecto1_texto: End-of-course project in Java: a DragonQuest-style RPG with monsters, chests and a weapon system. Applies interfaces, inheritance and object-oriented programming.
proyecto2_texto: EA FC 26 player search with league and club filters, player profiles and favourites saved in the browser.
footer_texto: Designed and developed by Jordi Estirado · 2026
proyectos_vacio: There are no projects with that technology.
carrera_dam_texto: I’m studying for a higher vocational diploma in Multiplatform Application Development, covering object-oriented Java, database design and application development.
carrera_practicas_texto: During my internship I work with business data and workflows. I like to understand how the people who use each screen actually do their jobs.
contacto_disponible: I’m looking for my first junior developer role. If your team is hiring, send me an email. I’d love to hear what you’re building.
contacto_linkedin_desc: Explore my background or send me a message.
contacto_github_desc: Browse the source code for my projects.
proyecto_tallerMecanico: Workshop portal connecting Laravel to Velneo so customers and mechanics can look up vehicles and manage repairs.
proyecto_ShareTicket: Android app for shared shopping lists. Each person can add items, group them by category and tick off purchases.
proyecto_atlas-de-aethria: Two-player turn-based strategy game for Windows with local play and peer-to-peer rooms.
proyecto_footballLeaugue: Web application for recording teams, players and results. Match results determine the league standings.
proyecto_FitnessApp: Android app for editing a personal profile, logging weight and tracking changes over time.
proyecto_CalculatorIMC: Android calculator with weight and height controls that display the resulting body mass index.
proyecto_retosJava: Java programming exercises covering FizzBuzz and anagram detection.
proyecto_astroPortfolioWeb: This portfolio presents my projects in three languages and lets visitors filter them by technology.
